home.title: Presentation Guide
home.subtitle: Al-Hadif Association
home.section1Content: The Al-Hadif Association is an expressive youth platform founded in the heart of the city of Safi, based on a deep conviction that positive change begins with the energy of the youth themselves. Our launch was not just an idea, but a response to a real need in our society: the need for a safe and stimulating space that brings young people together, invests in their talents, and directs their creative energies to serve their environment.
home.axis1Desc: We believe that young people are the true engine of development. We work to refine their skills and organize training courses and workshops that open up new prospects for them in their educational and professional aspirations.
home.axis2Desc: We contribute to creating a positive and dynamic environment by organizing cultural activities, exploratory trips, various festivals, and sports courses that strengthen collective spirit and fair competition.
home.axis3Desc: Encourage the values of solidarity, cooperation, and support in sustainable local development. We reinforce the values of solidarity and support in sustainable local development.
home.axis4: Promotion of the Region and its Heritage
home.axis4Desc: We work to highlight the geographical, historical, and heritage components of our region through educational and cultural activities aimed at strengthening the bond of young people with their local and national identity.

about.title: Our Identity and Our Vision
about.subtitle: Who we are and where we are going
about.whoWeAreContent: The Al-Hadif Association is an expressive youth platform founded in the heart of the city of Safi, based on a deep conviction that positive change begins with the energy of the youth themselves. Our launch was not just an idea, but a response to a real need in our society: the need for a safe and stimulating space that brings young people together, invests in their talents, and directs their creative energies to serve their environment.
about.visionContent: We aspire for young people to become the main driver of sustainable development and positive change.
about.missionContent: Empower the youth of our region with diverse skills by designing and implementing quality programs and initiatives in the educational, cultural, and sports fields. We work to strengthen the spirit of citizenship and volunteering, and to build effective partnerships with the various components of society to contribute to the achievement of comprehensive and sustainable local development.
about.valuesSubtitle: The values that guide our work
about.objectivesSubtitle: Through our work, we seek to achieve:
about.objective1: Build the capacities of young people and empower them
about.objective4: Expand the network of cooperation and partnerships

axes.title: Our Fields of Action and Our Programs
axes.subtitle: As a translation of our vision and mission on the ground, we organize our activities and programs into six integrated and interconnected axes of work. Each axis is carefully designed to meet specific needs in our society and to ensure a positive, deep, and lasting impact.
axes.axis1Motto: Our responsibility... we protect it today to pass it on to future generations
axes.axis1Desc: We believe that development can only be complete in a clean and healthy environment. The preservation of our natural environment is not just a choice, but a moral duty and a collective responsibility towards ourselves and future generations. Therefore, the Al-Hadif Association is committed to instilling environmental awareness in young people and transforming them from mere residents into active guardians and defenders of their environment.
axes.axis1Program1Desc: We work directly to improve the aesthetics of our region through field initiatives that raise awareness and create a tangible impact in the community.
axes.axis1Program2Desc: We seek to build an environmentally conscious generation, capable of adopting sustainable behaviors that preserve nature and support a greener future.
axes.axis2Motto: Our culture is our identity... we are proud of it and draw our creativity from it
axes.axis2Desc: We see in culture and heritage a window through which young people look at their history and their roots, and a rich source of inspiration and creativity. Therefore, we work at the Al-Hadif Association to create lively cultural spaces that allow young people to express themselves, deepen their knowledge of their local and national heritage, and contribute to the production of a diverse and innovative cultural scene.
axes.axis2Program1Desc: We offer young people and emerging talents a platform to develop their artistic and literary skills.
axes.axis2Program2Desc: We contribute to enriching the intellectual and cognitive dialogue in our region.
axes.axis2Program3Title: Revitalization of Local Heritage and its Promotion
axes.axis2Program3Desc: We work to strengthen the bond of young people with their roots and their history.
axes.axis3Motto: With science and knowledge, we build a generation capable of shaping the future
axes.axis3Desc: We at the Al-Hadif Association believe that education is the cornerstone of any real development project. Therefore, we place the axis of education at the heart of our strategy, and we seek through it to provide equal opportunities for all, to combat school dropout, and to provide young people with the knowledge tools that enable them to achieve their aspirations.
axes.axis3Program1Desc: This program aims to provide direct assistance to students who are experiencing academic difficulties.
axes.axis3Program2Desc: Believing that learning is a right for everyone and at all ages, this program targets young people and adolescents who have dropped out of school.
axes.axis3Program3Desc: We help young people make crucial decisions about their academic and professional path.
axes.axis3ImpactDesc: Reduction of school dropout, improvement of academic results, and empowerment of a generation of conscious young people capable of making informed decisions for their future.
axes.axis4Motto: We invest in people... to create leaders of change
axes.axis4Desc: We believe that volunteers are not just a workforce, but the beating heart of the association and its renewed spirit. Therefore, we do not just invite them to participate, but we aspire to invest in them and provide them with the skills and knowledge that make them effective leaders in their community. This axis is the engine that feeds all our other axes of work and ensures their continuity and development.
axes.axis4Program1Desc: We ensure that every volunteer at the Al-Hadif Association is an ambassador for our cause and qualified to perform their tasks with efficiency and a high sense of responsibility.
axes.axis4Program2Desc: We seek to empower ambitious young people, so that they become capable of launching their own initiatives and managing them with confidence and effectiveness in the future.
axes.axis5Motto: Our solidarity is a strength... with it, we draw a smile and alleviate suffering
axes.axis5Desc: Because real development cannot be complete without achieving social solidarity, we place social and humanitarian work at the forefront of our priorities at the Al-Hadif Association. We believe that our duty extends to standing by the most needy categories of our society, lending them a hand, and establishing a culture of giving and solidarity among all components of the region.
axes.axis5Program1Desc: We seek to reach remote areas and families in need of urgent support by organizing regular humanitarian convoys.
axes.axis5Program2Desc: We work to provide continuous and organized support to low-income families and orphans to ensure a dignified life.
axes.axis5Program3Desc: We respond to the needs of our community and launch special humanitarian campaigns and initiatives according to the season and urgent needs.
axes.axis6Motto: With sport, we create champions... and build a dynamic and positive society
axes.axis6Desc: We at the Al-Hadif Association believe that sport is not just a physical activity, but a real school of life where young people learn fundamental values such as patience, respect, team spirit, and fair competition. Through the sports and leisure axis, we seek to create sports and recreational spaces that allow young people to practice their hobbies, discover their talents, and develop their personalities in a healthy and stimulating environment.
axes.axis6Program1Desc: We organize regular sports championships in various sports, aimed at creating noble competition that allows young people to show their talents, develop their skills, and acquire values of teamwork and discipline.
axes.axis6Program2Desc: We organize open recreational days for children and young people, filled with activities and games that combine fun and learning. We believe that play is a natural way to develop the social and creative skills.
axes.axis6Program3Desc: We seek to promote a positive sports culture, through awareness workshops and activities that highlight the importance of sport as a healthy lifestyle and a source of positive energy.
axes.forwardDesc: Through these six axes, we seek to build a cohesive, conscious, and creative society. We believe that real development begins with young people, and that each of these areas contributes to shaping a better future for our region and our country.
